# Copilot instructions

See `AGENTS.md` in the repository root for architecture, working agreements and commands.

Additional guidance for chat and review:

- Prefer the simplest change that satisfies the requirement. This codebase is
  deliberately small; do not introduce patterns it does not already use unless asked.
- When a request spans front end and back end, state the full list of files you intend
  to touch before editing, so the reviewer can spot a missing layer early.
- When you are unsure whether a behaviour is intended, say so rather than guessing.
